blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — South Cotabato has stepped up preparations for the projected “super” El Niño, with water facilities, disaster funds, and relief supplies ready amid concerns about prolonged severe dry conditions that could affect farms, livestock, and public health. Gov. Reynaldo Tamayo Jr. said the province has prepared early for the possible effects of a severe El Niño, including ensuring the availability of water trucks, water impounding facilities and food packs. “We have water trucks, we have impounding facilities. Everything has been set up,” Tamayo told reporters. READ: Recto orders faster public spending, early procurement for super El NiñoTamayo said the […]...
